words.meaning: The occurrence of events by chance in a happy or beneficial way
words.sentence1: Finding my lost childhood book at the flea market was pure serendipity. (Finding my lost childhood book at the flea market was pure serendipity.)
words.sentence2: A fortunate serendipity led them to meet the renowned artist during their walk. (A fortunate serendipity led them to meet the renowned artist during their walk.)

words.meaning: The time spent lingering around the table after a meal, conversing
words.sentence1: Disfrutamos de una larga sobremesa despues del almuerzo familiar. (We enjoyed a long post-meal conversation after the family lunch.)
words.sentence2: La sobremesa es una tradicion hermosa para compartir historias. (The after-meal conversation is a beautiful tradition for sharing stories.)

words.meaning: A person who saunters around observing society, a wanderer
words.sentence1: Il etait un vrai flaneur, observant les details caches de Paris. (He was a true wanderer, observing the hidden details of Paris.)
words.sentence2: Le flaneur profite de l'apres-midi sans se presser dans les rues. (The stroller enjoys the afternoon without rushing through the streets.)

words.meaning: A quality of coziness, friendliness, and belonging
words.sentence1: Die Huettestrahlte eine wundersame Gemuetlichkeit aus. (The cabin radiated a wonderful sense of coziness.)
words.sentence2: Wir genossen die Gemuetlichkeit des warmen Kaminfeuers am Abend. (We enjoyed the coziness of the warm fireplace in the evening.)

words.meaning: A profound, mysterious sense of the beauty of the universe
words.sentence1: Sono yama no keshiki ni fukai yugen o kanjita. (I felt a deep sense of mysterious grace in the mountain landscape.)
words.sentence2: Yugen wa nihon no dento teki na biishiki no hitotsu desu. (Yugen is one of the traditional aesthetic sensibilities of Japan.)

words.meaning: To rest or spend time in the shade during the heat of midday
words.sentence1: Nel pomeriggio amiamo meriggiare sotto i grandi alberi del giardino. (In the afternoon we love to rest in the shade under the big trees in the garden.)
words.sentence2: Il pastore decise di meriggiare vicino alla fonte fresca. (The shepherd decided to rest in the shade near the cool spring.)

words.meaning: Landscape painting featuring mountains and water, nature's scenery
words.sentence1: Ta hen xihuan guanmo guandai de shanshui hua. (He really likes observing traditional landscape paintings.)
words.sentence2: Zhege cunluo de ziran shanshui jingsel feichang zhangli. (The natural mountain and water scenery of this village is very charming.)

words.meaning: To be warm, cozy, and comforting in atmosphere
words.sentence1: Geu bangenun chwiyulhan nalssie cham namdutda. (That room is truly cozy and warm on a chilly day.)
words.sentence2: Eommanuui ttatteutan sonmokkkeseo namdutan gibuni deunda. (A cozy feeling arises from mother's warm touch.)

words.meaning: Frangipani flower, symbolizing purity and devotion in daily life
words.sentence1: Phka chompa rik krub chork knong chomnern douch. (Frangipani flowers bloom all over the garden.)
words.sentence2: Neak srok thveu mchas phka chompa dael ban chuop chabas. (The villagers cherish the frangipani flowers they encounter.)

words.sentence1: Ons het die geselligheid rondom die vuur baie geniet. (We thoroughly enjoyed the sociability around the fire.)
words.sentence2: Daar was 'n wonderlike atmosfeer van geselligheid by die braai. (There was a wonderful atmosphere of cheerfulness at the barbecue.)
